result.summary: A dark-themed AI coding assistant composer widget: a rounded rectangle with a subtle lighter-gray border on a dark charcoal background. The upper area holds two lines of gray placeholder/help text starting with 'Help you write code,' with a small gray sparkle icon at the far right. The bottom toolbar, read left to right, has a plus icon, a hand icon with 'Manual Approval' and chevron, an '@' with 'Agent' and chevron, then on the right the model label 'deepseek-v4.1-flash' with chevron, a microphone icon, and a dark green rounded-square send button containing a white upward arrow. No tabs, headers, or text appear above or below the box.
